ci-capture-25.alt: Twenty-five 95% confidence intervals, one per row, each from a simulated random sample of 400 from a population where the true proportion is p = 0.60, shown as a dashed vertical line. Each interval is drawn as a bar with a dot at its sample proportion. 22 of the 25 intervals cross the line and capture p; 3 miss it and are drawn in orange. The intervals have nearly the same length but are centered at different sample proportions.
